name: ask n2 about a real service and draw the d3 knowledge graph

steps.text: Query n2 for the service o2o-cart-order-store-my-ppe. Use search_brain and get_entity - it IS in the brain, with datadog and ai:correlation sources. Tell me its pods, its dependencies and what is correlated to it, then draw a d3 knowledge graph of it on the canvas.
